verdict.rationale: Intel publishes an llms.txt at intel.com, confirmed by a live HTTP 200 probe, and an llms-full.txt that mentions Core Ultra Series 2, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs that cover this product family. Coverage is corporate-wide, and the Series 2 content is a single thin line with no 258V-specific detail. Missing for 10: product- or SKU-specific agent-oriented docs for the Core Ultra 7 258V, depth of llms-full.txt coverage beyond one spec line, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can use it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
